Quillmark

Quillmark turns a folder of Jupyter notebooks into a static website that loads quickly, works without JavaScript, and can be hosted anywhere. It executes each notebook in a clean kernel, caches the outputs, and renders them with a small set of readable themes.

We built it because our lab kept publishing analysis notebooks as screenshots, which nobody could search or copy from. Quillmark keeps the code, the prose, and the plots together, and it rebuilds only the cells that changed.

Features

  • Incremental builds keyed on cell content
  • Hidden cells with the hide tag
  • Optional PDF export through a headless browser

Getting started

pip install quillmark
quillmark build notebooks/

The full guide lives at quillmark.readthedocs.io.
